notes.title: No Time For Loot!
notes.content:
[h1][b][u]NO TIME TO LOOT![/u][/b][/h1][p]Another steam festival has begun that speaks to what Highreach is all about! Well a part of it because how else can you build stunning airships and lively settlements without loot?! The no time to loot event brought to you by Human Qube and in collaboration with Sidekick Publishing highlights diversity and creativity of loot driven designed games! You can expect to see 340+ participating titles and your wishlist to surely grow![/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]WHAT HAVE WE BEEN UP TO?[/u][/b][/h2][p]In the downtime (not actual downtime) between events, we’re plugging away at making Highreach the best it can be! Currently We’ve been adding more visual options to our character creator while also giving some light touch ups to the character models themselves![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/58a7857e25548b8fb55810f61c4ec502e8ccb699.png"][/img][/p][p]Environments and points of interest are also coming together as we start bringing dungeons and Highreach to life.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/ab0d26d0af56f8001141e150aef91b0d7c3a45ef.png"][/img][/p][h2][b][u]STEAM STREAM[/u][/b][/h2][p]Like most events we’ll be streaming on our steam page to give you a little insight on Highreach as we venture through the demo mode of the game we’ve showcased back at Gamescom! Be sure to catch the stream on September 23nd at 6PM CEST![/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being part of this amazing journey with us.[/p][p]If you’re excited about what’s to come, spread the word on our social channels:[/p][p][url="https://highreach.carrd.co/"]https://highreach.carrd.co/[/url]☁️[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update - Farming, Food & User inter...Face
notes.content:
[p]Greetings adventurers!
First off we would just like to thank you all for following along with our journey as we make Highreach a reality! As you know a lot goes on in the background of game development so we wanted to give you a little peek at what we’ve up to![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Copper Tools[/b][/h3][p]As we all know, every good survival game comes with its many tiers of weapons and tools! With the starter tool finished, we’ve started working on copper weapons, tools, and armor![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/67e222d0c4dcc8f8156566cdf3cd0fd44ee7787c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Toil the Soil[/b][/h3][p]If you’re going to be cooking, you’re going to need the freshest of ingredients! Players can look forward to growing their own food and trees! This also means tending to your crops with water and of course harvesting![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/3761182ff97071fdcaf6505c6b6c4673b092f803.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Ring the Dinner Bell[/b][/h3][p]So far adventurers have only been able to survive off simple berries, mushrooms, and water from ponds or collected from the rain. We’re working away to bring in a variety of meals for you to cook. These meals will bring in a variety of buffs for your characters like more health, better stamina, and overall stat increases. Of course, you can also prepare your freshly harvested produce at the cooking station![/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/7b009ca97e43528c3e3e6d90348d238637589a38.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/525d168e2cac210bed797a960e6f6874188ea5f8.png"][/img][/carousel][h3][b]New UI[/b][/h3][p]We’re currently adjusting our current UI to be more accessible, easy to understand, and down right styling.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/abeafc988039571b117812068a8f478b909e4cbc.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Upgrading the Options Menu[/b][/h3][p]We’re pretty proud of ourselves with how our menu options are turning out (by we I mean we should be patting our Lead Dev on the back for this one). Players will of course have the go to graphical, sound, and etc options but we’ve also put a ton of effort into our accessibility options such as color blindness. With that we made sure to cover types like Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/cb3c38624385f495a1fabec6ea46b82e7e2e8586.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s all for now adventurers. Keep your eyes to the skies for what we have cooking in our next update![/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being part of this amazing journey with us.[/p][p]If you’re excited about what’s to come, spread the word on our social channels:[/p][p][url="https://highreach.carrd.co/"]https://highreach.carrd.co/[/url] ☁️[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The bequest of mushroom colonies! - Development Update
notes.content:
Once a thriving farmland, now an eerie, bioluminescent battleground—the CobaltCap Thicket in Highreach has been overrun by towering fungi and menacing creatures. At its heart loom colossal mushroom colonies, spreading their sinister influence across the land. But beware: the deeper you go, the deadlier it becomes.

[h2]Face the Spore Fiends[/h2]
These relentless fungal horrors won’t go down easily. Agile and brutal, they launch themselves at intruders, summon explosive spores, and unleash toxic clouds. But if you dare to stand your ground, they drop valuable mushroom fibers—a resource worth fighting for!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/77eb00c5e4948b7b728744a9b0dc6a54c72fff2a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Panic Chickens – Best Left Undisturbed[/h2]
At first glance, these peculiar birds seem harmless, pecking away in the undergrowth. As long as you leave their nests alone, they won’t bother you. But if you dare to steal their eggs, be ready for a fight! These mushroom-infested creatures will chase intruders relentlessly, and if they catch you… well, let’s just say their final act is explosive. Their eggs, however, are a valuable cooking ingredient—if you’re bold enough to take them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/8123c3041302d9c727378b81bb0581abc10e66f9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mushroom-Infected Raccoons – A Tragic Fate[/h2]
Unlike their aggressive counterparts, these poor creatures have succumbed to the infestation without a fight. Twisted by the fungi, they wander the Thicket in a harmless daze, serving as a grim reminder of what happens to those who stay too long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/3e9fc28deee386becf6a967189d2a2f5b65cb237.jpg[/img]

[h1]Will You Brave the CobaltCap Thicket?[/h1]
Only the strongest will make it out alive—but the rewards are worth the risk. Are you ready to face the horrors that lurk beneath the towering mushrooms?

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being part of this amazing journey with us.
If you’re excited about what’s to come, spread the word on our social channels:
https://highreach.carrd.co/ ☁️

See you in the Thicket… if you make it back. 🌑🍄🔥

notes.title: Airship Parts! - Development Update
notes.content:
Survivors, the time has come to build not just a shelter, but a home in the skies! With our latest update, Highreach now allows you to construct fully customizable airships, giving you the freedom to create anything from a nimble explorer’s craft to a grand floating fortress.

[b]Your Airship, Your Design[/b]
Every airship starts as an expandable platform, ready for your creativity to take flight! Use a mix of standard building parts and airship-specific components to craft your perfect aerial base. Whether you want to construct a sleek sky vessel or a floating campfire-lit refuge, the choice is yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/46773b3ae0d36174ec8ecb31ebe4eddee023077a.jpg[/img]

[b]Essential Airship Parts[/b]
To ensure your airship is both functional and efficient, we’ve added a variety of new components:

[list]
[*] Steering Wheel – Take control and navigate the vast skies.
[*] Rotor Walls & Velocity Rotors – Increase horizontal speed and cover distances faster.
[*] Rotor Platforms – Gain better vertical mobility to ascend and descend swiftly.
[*] Rudders – Improve your ship’s rotation rate for precise maneuvering.
[*] Balloon Platforms – Expand your maximum weight capacity before experiencing slowdowns.
[*] Fuel Tanks – Store more fuel for extended journeys.
[*] Docking Station – Secure your airship to an island dock for safe landings.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/19ae09389a1b337552ca83f4f10aa3ebfcaeed62.jpg[/img]

Configure, Balance, and Master the Skies!Building a successful airship is about finding the right balance—optimize speed, weight, and mobility to create the perfect flying machine.

[b]New Decorative Items![/b]
Your airship should be as stylish as it is functional! We’ve introduced a range of new decorative items to add personality and flair to your airborne home. Whether you're going for elegance, rugged survivalism, or something entirely unique, there's something for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/57828e6724bd2e86b90a405da82794def3408bba.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/98d8091aa883af3034a37ce6fd2952121dcf64bb.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being part of this amazing journey with us.

See you in the skies! 🌥️

And find us on our socials (Bluesky, TikTok, Instagram, X) here: https://highreach.carrd.co/

notes.title: Exploring the World of Highreach: Points of Interest
notes.content:
[h3]Adventurers, get ready![/h3]
The world of Highreach is coming to life with Points of Interest (POIs)—dynamic locations that can spawn enemies, hold valuable loot, and even play a crucial role in your journey through the game.

[h1]What is a Point of Interest?[/h1]
POIs are spawned structures that are scattered around the world, just waiting for you to explore them.
They can be towering structures as well as small enemy camps. It is always worth exploring POIs, sometimes for loot and sometimes for a combat challenge!
Loot chests can hold crucial recipes, valuable jewelry and even quest relevant items.
Some POIs even tie into the backstory of companion characters.
But all this loot needs to be guarded of cause, bigger POIs are home to a considerable number of enemies, some even unique to their structures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/e5a7ce3eec90b1cdf7e6f2a8c8b2193514b76765.jpg[/img]

[h1]How Points of Interest Work[/h1]
Each island in Highreach features pre-designed spawn locations for POIs, ensuring that every adventure feels fresh and exciting. These locations have a chance-based system, meaning different POIs can appear in different places with each playthrough. To keep exploration balanced, a sophisticated system distributes and weights POIs based on their size and type—creating an immersive and different world every time you set foot in it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/91b29fc0726e9579a4a508e39daa4dbdcca9b680.jpg[/img]

[h1]Different Sizes, Different Challenges[/h1]
POIs come in four sizes, each offering unique opportunities:
[list]
[*] Tiny – Mostly decorative, but some hide special interactions.
[*] Small – Expect a few enemies and minor loot rewards.
[*] Medium & Large – These are full-scale structures filled with enemies and multiple loot chests, making them high-risk, high-reward locations!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/9618e4d6e94b85246e0be7c6edea9438ad21a76d.jpg[/img]

[h1]The First Biome’s POI Types[/h1]
As you explore the first biome, you’ll encounter three distinct POI types:
[list]
[*] Rodling Camps – Hostile enemy settlements filled with danger and loot.
[*] Fallen Kingdom – Ancient ruins with secrets waiting to be uncovered.
[*] Abandoned Camps – Scattered remnants of past explorers… but are they truly abandoned?
[/list]
And this is just the beginning! Future updates will reveal even more POI types, ensuring there’s always something new to discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/86951a848f519016762071eb4c70066fe65e5f31.jpg[/img]
[h1]Join the Adventure![/h1]

What do you think of the POI system?
Let us know in discussions, leave a like, and share your thoughts!
If you’re excited about what’s to come, spread the word on our social channels:
https://highreach.carrd.co/ ☁️

Stay tuned for more updates, and we’ll see you in Highreach! ✨

notes.title: Airship! - Development Update
notes.content:
The skies of Highreach are calling, and we’re thrilled to announce the latest and most ambitious addition to the game: Airships! This transformative feature is not only a game-changer for the way you explore the world, but it’s also a love letter to creative freedom and the spirit of adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/9a1ffffb247b66bbe5b45097674e3ffa15a5d45a.png[/img]

[b]Why Airships?[/b]
In a game set on a continent of floating, procedurally generated islands, the ability to traverse the skies just feels right. Airships are the missing piece of the puzzle, and now, they’re here to give you the ultimate freedom: the skies are yours to explore!

Your airship isn’t just a mode of transport - it’s your mobile sanctuary, your trusty steed of the skies. Whether soaring to far-off islands, scouting for resources, or evading deadly threats, the airship expands your exploration options like never before.

We've explored other modes of traversal, but we came to the conclusion, that airship should be a core feature for Highreach and would be the most useful way of traversal.
It also serves as and expandable, movable base, so you no longer have to build several bases all over the world (you still can of course!), but you can take your base and all resources you have with you.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/cc83dd08369348f085bd52e6d856721109e64b25.jpg[/img]

[b]How You Fly[/b]
Flying an airship in Highreach feels as epic as it sounds. Maneuver the large, customizable vessel freely around the floating islands. You’ll take full control of your vessel:

Adjust horizontal and vertical speeds and rotate your vessel via a steering wheel, similar to a ship and fly across the floating islands.
Your steering control panel gives you an overview of your airship engine's powers, fuel, a compass and everything you need on your journey.

Flying isn’t just a way to get from A to B - it’s an immersive experience that ties directly into the sense of scale and wonder Highreach offers. 


[b]Highly Customizable, Entirely Yours[/b]
Your airship isn’t a one-size-fits-all vehicle. It’s highly customizable, giving you the freedom to design it according to your vision. Want a sleek explorer built for speed? Or a floating fortress that dominates the skies? It’s up to you. With numerous components to build, tweak, and improve, the airship is a true extension of your creativity and ingenuity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149183/2ccc68a9005be88a9582f3c7ca72d42ad1f37556.png[/img]

Every building structure has an effect on your airship movement, every piece affects the weight and the space you may use.
Customizing your airship isn’t just cosmetic - your choices matter. From propellers to turbines, every piece you add will affect your airship’s performance, balancing weight, speed, fuel and functionality. Whether you’re decking it out for combat or expanding it for additional living space, every decision shapes your journey.

The introduction of airships doesn’t just change how you explore—it introduces entirely new gameplay possibilities, including managing your airship camp and creating a floating main base.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
This is just the beginning. In future updates, we’ll dive deeper into the systems surrounding airship design and management, including how weight, speed, and components interact to create a dynamic and engaging experience.

The airship is more than a feature—it’s a promise of freedom, creativity, and adventure. We can’t wait to see the incredible designs you create and the daring journeys you’ll take in the skies of Highreach.

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being part of this amazing journey with us.

See you in the skies! 🌥️

And find us on our socials (X, Instagram, Bluesky, TikTok) here: https://highreach.carrd.co/
